newsitem.title: USA: BellSouth buys 57 pct stake in Tele 2000.
newsitem.headline: BellSouth buys 57 pct stake in Tele 2000.

text.p: BellSouth Corp on Thursday said it acquired a 57 percent stake in the Peru telecommunications company, Tele 2000, for about $110 million.
The purchase involved about 73 million shares of Tele 2000.

Tele 2000 serves more than 100,000 customers in the Peruvian capital of Lima and the surrounding areas along the Pacific coast, offering paging, cable television, directories, pay phone and mobile data services.
It also owns and operates a fiber-optic network in Lima and Callao, BellSouth said.
BellSouth, which provides telecommunications and wireless services, had been in talks with the company for over a year.
In Lima, Tele 2000 was unchanged at 4.90 soles in light trading of just 2,750 shares.
